t: You're looking at Lansdowne House on Lansdowne Road in Holland Park, a Grade II listed, eight-storey building put up between 1902 and 1904. William Flockhart designed it for the mining magnate Sir Edmund Davis, with apartments and artists' studios. A blue plaque names artists who worked here, including Charles Ricketts and Glyn Philpot. In the recording studio that later took its name from the building, Denis Preston, a record producer and studio owner, was influential in British jazz and skiffle from the 1940s to the 1960s.
